context_requirements: NR5A2 expression and active transcriptional program
cell line must be dependent on NR5A2 for survival or proliferation
presence of NR5A2 coactivators and target gene chromatin accessibility
falsifiers: consistent concentration-dependent changes in NR5A2 target genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
reproducible growth inhibition or apoptosis in NR5A2-expressing lines but not in NR5A2-negative lines
changes in cholesterol synthesis or bile acid pathway landmark genes after treatment
